environment.description: Same Node.js 18 service deployed on ECS Fargate but fronted by AWS API Gateway (REST API) with a request validator attached to the POST method. The API Gateway uses a JSON Schema model definition on the request body that enforces 'updates' must be an object with 'additionalProperties' set to a schema requiring each value to have only 'string' or 'number' typed leaf properties (no nested objects allowed beyond depth 1). The model uses 'maxProperties: 20' and explicitly sets 'patternProperties' with regex '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,30}$' for allowed keys. The validator is configured with 'validateRequestBody: true' and 'validateRequestParameters: true'. Integration type is HTTP_PROXY to the internal ALB. Additionally, the API Gateway resource policy restricts invoke access to specific IAM roles via aws:PrincipalArn condition.

config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway with restricted egress to AWS services only
